recorded.prompt:q-check:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:a: The sum formula counts every interval that would be running, the candidate included. 5 > 4, so a fails.
recorded.prompt:q-check:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:b: The test is the 'sum of the demands', not the largest demand.
recorded.prompt:q-check:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-check:c: The cap is on summed demands (crews), not on how many jobs are running: 'crews is the job's demand'.
recorded.prompt:q-dip:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dip:b: "The capacity stays at ... the most crews the season ever has". A capacity of 3 would cap every week at 3, not 5.
recorded.prompt:q-dip:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dip:c: "a fixed interval of demand 3 − a_w" (peak − available). That is 5 − 3 = 2, not 3.
recorded.prompt:q-dip:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-dip:d: "Set the capacity to the peak". The peak here is 5, not 3.
recorded.prompt:q-window:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:a: Ranges are "[a, b - j.weeks]". The Design Note also warns about "a domain built with b where b − d was meant".
recorded.prompt:q-window:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:c: The starts are "a, a+1, …, b − d". That ends at 6 and 17, not at 5 and 16.
recorded.prompt:q-window:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-window:d: The starts begin at the window's opening a (4 and 15), per "a, a+1, …, b − d".
